about: Blair Russ is a partner at Tomlinson Bomsztyk Russ in Seattle, Washington. He is an experienced civil litigator known for achieving favorable outcomes for his clients in trials and arbitration. His proficiency spans:

Mr. Russ represents a diverse clientele throughout the state, encompassing entities like construction firms, property developers, financial institutions specializing in construction, advisory services in construction, residential community associations, franchise holders, and private individuals. Moreover, he has adeptly settled intricate legal matters ranging from public infrastructure project disputes, real estate quarrels, corporate conflicts, intellectual property violations, partnership disagreements and civil rights infringement to severe personal injury cases. He has also secured multimillion-dollar awards and settlements for business proprietors.

After completing his bachelor’s cum laude from the University of Washington in Seattle in 2004, Mr. Russ received his J.D. from Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law – Yeshiva University in 2007. He has been licensed to practice in Washington and New York since 2008 and is admitted to the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington.

Mr. Russ has been acknowledged by many prestigious legal organizations, such as the National Trial Lawyers (Top 40 Under 40 list) and the American Society of legal Advocates (Top 40 Under 40 list). Lawyers. Additionally, he boasts a perfect “10.0” rating on Avvo.
